arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%w', date) AS INTEGER) AS day_number,
       CASE strftime('%w', date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions
GROUP BY day_number
ORDER BY day_number
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions for each day of the week, Sunday first and then Monday through Saturday.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, and including those with errors or negative amounts.
The day of the week comes from the transaction timestamp as recorded, with no time zone adjustment.
